relations: As the water jet arc descends and flattens, its broad droplet-filled crest thins into a narrower ribbon.
As the arc lowers, the tall splash plume on the left shrinks and settles.
While the water ripples, swimmers and standing figures remain in place, bobbing gently with the surface.
caption: The video captures a swimming pool filmed at water level against a warm orange sunset sky and silhouetted hills. A jet of water arcs across the pool from right to left, landing in a tall plume at the left, while its right end stays near heads bobbing in the middle and additional people stand at the right edge beside a white structure. Over time the stream lowers and flattens, its broad droplet-filled crest thinning into a narrower ribbon. The tall splash plume on the left shrinks and settles as the arc descends. Rippling water fills the foreground, and a blurred dark object intrudes at the right edge and bottom, with the view shifting slightly. The swimmers and standing figures remain essentially in place, rising and falling gently with the surface.
